summary: Captured two lessons learned from the 40 item usage/dormant audit into the wonder-cookbook skill and CB-bigquery data-research-patterns playbook: (1) trailing 'F' suffix on 40* item numbers is a real distinct frozen-variant item, not an annotation to strip, and (2) R&D/DRAFT status alone can't determine whether a menu item is a stale test draft or active WIP -- needs human confirmation. Also documented that item_version_change_logs.is_system_action under-flags known service accounts (SCC_SYNC, Wonder Create).

Wrote a new personal workflow skill 'check-40-item-dormant-candidacy' distilling this session's entire 40 item/menu item dormant-audit process (usage query, Excel sheet building, dormant confirmation sheet, 90-day human-edit recency check, F-suffix and is_system_action gotchas), plus a matching recognition rule wired into CLAUDE.md.

Updated 'A2-Data Research/Uncutover 40 Item Usage Analysis.md' to reflect the full evolution of the analysis: Menu Item Dormant Confirmation (152 items) and B2B 88 Dormant Confirmation (78 items) sheets, No usage 40 items (244) sheet, 90-day human-edit recency checks, and the F-suffix data quality correction (Not sold 40 scope 405->408).

Updated 'A2-Data Research/Uncutover 40 Item Usage Analysis.md' again to reflect sheet consolidation (HDR Recipe Dormant Confirmation merged into Menu/7 Dormant Confirmation, 159 rows) and the removal of 29 already-DORMANT rows from No usage 40 items (244->215).
